This page lists 44 Ghostty Terminal keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `ghostty.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in Ghostty Terminal to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t ghostty.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/ghostty.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/Ghostty.app`; if Ghostty Terminal lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## Window Management

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘N` | New window |
| `⇧⌘W` | Close window |
| `⇧⌥⌘W` | Close all windows |
| `⌘⏎` | Toggle fullscreen |
| `⌃⌘F` | Toggle fullscreen (alt) |
| `⌘Q` | Quit application |

## Tab Management

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘T` | New tab |
| `⌘W` | Close tab/surface |
| `⇧⌘[` | Previous tab |
| `⇧⌘]` | Next tab |
| `⌘1-8` | Go to tab 1-8 |
| `⌘9` | Go to last tab |

## Split Management

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘D` | New split (right) |
| `⇧⌘D` | New split (down) |
| `⌘[` | Focus previous split |
| `⌘]` | Focus next split |
| `⌥⌘↑` | Focus split up |
| `⌥⌘↓` | Focus split down |
| `⌥⌘←` | Focus split left |
| `⌥⌘→` | Focus split right |
| `⇧⌘⏎` | Toggle split zoom |
| `⌃⌘↑` | Resize split up |
| `⌃⌘↓` | Resize split down |
| `⌃⌘←` | Resize split left |
| `⌃⌘→` | Resize split right |
| `⌃⌘=` | Equalize splits |

## Copy & Paste

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘C` | Copy |
| `⌘V` | Paste |

## Text Navigation

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘Home` | Scroll to top |
| `⌘End` | Scroll to bottom |
| `⌘⇞` | Scroll page up |
| `⌘⇟` | Scroll page down |
| `⌘↑` | Jump to previous prompt |
| `⌘↓` | Jump to next prompt |
| `⌘K` | Clear screen |

## Font Size

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘+` | Increase font size |
| `⌘=` | Increase font size |
| `⌘-` | Decrease font size |
| `⌘0` | Reset font size |

## Configuration

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘,` | Open config |
| `⇧⌘,` | Reload config |

## Inspector

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌥⌘I` | Toggle inspector |

## Scrollback

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⇧⌘J` | Write scrollback to file (paste) |
| `⇧⌥⌘J` | Write scrollback to file (open) |

## Template file

The full [`ghostty.keyly`](https://github.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/blob/main/templates/ghostty.keyly) file. Copy it into `~/.config/keyly/templates/` to edit it, or [write your own](/configuration/custom-shortcuts/).
